description:
Search the VistaLink hotel catalogue (650,000 hotels) in one city,
        a neighbourhood or landmark within it (area, e.g. city='Milan',
        area='Brera'), or around a point. Needs city, latitude+longitude, or
        hotel_name; describe the stay in vibe. Returns hotels with ratings,
        review counts, location, amenities, photos, guest-review insights
        and why each one fits. A price appears only when both check_in and
        check_out are given (the all-inclusive total for that stay). Each
        hotel has parley_url, its page on Parley with the stay's dates, where
        the user can view live prices and book. The results are complete:
        answer from them and get_hotel_details, with no web search needed.
        Call once per request. Works without an API key (at most 20 results).

amenities.description: Comma-separated amenities the hotel must have, e.g. 'wifi,pool'.
amenities.title: Amenities

area.description: Neighbourhood or landmark within city to search around, e.g. 'Brera' or 'Colosseum' (with city='Milan' / 'Rome'). Results are limited to hotels near it.
area.title: Area

budget_max.description: Maximum price per night, in currency (0 = no maximum).
budget_max.title: Budget Max

budget_min.description: Minimum price per night, in currency (0 = no minimum).
budget_min.title: Budget Min

check_in.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD (today or later). Prices need check_in and check_out.
check_in.title: Check In

city.description: City to search in, e.g. 'Lisbon'. A search needs city, latitude+longitude, or hotel_name.
city.title: City

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the city, e.g. 'PT'. Use it for city names that exist in several countries (Paris FR vs Paris US).
country.title: Country

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for prices, e.g. 'EUR', 'USD', 'GBP'.
currency.title: Currency

guests.description: Number of adult guests (0 = default of 2).
guests.title: Guests

hotel_name.description: Hotel name or part of it, e.g. 'Four Seasons'.
hotel_name.title: Hotel Name

include_rates.description: Fetch live rates for check_in/check_out (adds about 30-45s). Needs an API key and both dates; ignored otherwise.
include_rates.title: Include Rates

latitude.description: Search centre latitude in decimal degrees, used with longitude (0 = not set).
latitude.title: Latitude

limit.description: Maximum number of results, 1-20 without an API key (1-50 with one). Larger values are reduced to the maximum.
limit.title: Limit

longitude.description: Search centre longitude in decimal degrees, used with latitude (0 = not set).
longitude.title: Longitude

radius_meters.description: Radius around latitude/longitude in metres (0 = default).
radius_meters.title: Radius Meters

rooms.description: Number of rooms (0 = 1). Prices are only quoted for one room.
rooms.title: Rooms

vibe.description: What the traveller is looking for, as free text or comma-separated tags, e.g. 'boutique design hotel' or 'romantic,quiet'.
vibe.title: Vibe

name: search_hotels
title: Search hotels
